[LCSP.1.3] The factoring is strict: `realtime` ⊃ `constspace`.
Every `realtime` program is also `constspace` by construction.
A dialect resolver MAY infer `constspace` from `realtime`; it MAY
also leave the inference to the runtime (treating the flags as
independent `CapabilityInfo` tags). The reference compiler treats them as
independent (no auto-promotion) per [LCSP.5.4].
